title: Relative dualizing adjunction and its value on the structure sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the derived categories and their full quasi-coherent subcategories [def-pc-derived-category], and the existing derived direct image $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. A relative dualizing adjunction consists of a proof that $Rf_*$ preserves quasi-coherent cohomology, a functor $f^!:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(S)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$, an adjunction $Rf_*\dashv f^!$, and a proof that $\mathcal O_S[0]$ belongs to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(S)$. Its associated complex is the underlying object of $f^!(\mathcal O_S[0])$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. This is data, without an assertion that it exists for an arbitrary $f$.
